faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the HBCSE Scientific Assistant (B) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the HBCSE Scientific Assistant (B) recruitment is 19th September 2026. Ensure you apply well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Scientific Assistant (B) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a full-time B.Sc. in Mathematics or Computer Science with at least 60% marks. Knowledge of personal computers and 0-2 years of teaching experience are also required. An M.Sc. degree is considered desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Scientific Assistant (B) post is 28 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Scientific Assistant (B) position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 73020.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Scientific Assistant (B) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Scientific Assistant (B) post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the HBCSE Scientific Assistant (B) recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Scientific Assistant (B) role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test followed by a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any work experience required for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates need to have 0-2 years of teaching experience in Mathematics or Computer Science.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is recommended to download and read it thoroughly.

faq.question: Q10. How should I apply for this position?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website or the provided 'Apply Online' link on or before the last date of application.
